purpose: Allow VASTcode21 to observe any external information that may affect XAUUSD or BTCUSD while keeping execution restricted to those two assets.
discovery_rule: Do not assume a source, market or event is relevant. Measure whether it adds stable out-of-sample information for XAUUSD or BTCUSD, by regime and lag.
candidate_context_families: inflation employment growth and liquidity data
interest rates nominal yields real yields and yield curves
equity indices volatility and broad risk sentiment
commodities energy and related inflation-sensitive markets
gold physical flows ETF flows central-bank activity and positioning
BTC spot ETF flows and institutional flow proxies
crypto spot futures perpetuals options basis funding open interest liquidations and volatility
on-chain exchange miner whale and stablecoin flow data
crypto regulation exchange outages hacks insolvencies and protocol events
market liquidity spreads depth volume and session structure
cross-asset lead-lag correlation causality and regime shifts
news sentiment topic intensity surprise magnitude and persistence
